fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can quickly identify the property from the road.
• Trim or thin the dense vegetation along the driveway to keep the travel path clear for emergency vehicles.
• Cut back vegetation growing close to the detached structure to keep that building reachable on foot.
• Clear a path along at least one side of the main residence to allow responders to move between the front and rear of the property.
• Keep any gates blocking rear access unlocked or mark them clearly so responders are not slowed searching for an entry point.
• Mark the driveway entrance width clearly if vegetation or landscaping narrows the opening, so drivers of larger emergency vehicles can judge clearance before entering.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back tree branches and shrubs that are directly touching or overhanging the roof and exterior walls of the structure.
• Thin the dense tree clusters near the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove low-hanging branches from large trees near the structure up to at least 10 feet above the ground.
• Clear brush from the area identified near the structure to reduce the amount of burnable material close to the building.
• Cut back or remove ground vegetation that is growing directly against the foundation and exterior walls.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure so their canopies are not touching each other.
• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches and vegetation along both sides so vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Mow or cut down ground vegetation along the driveway and access route to keep the travel path visible and passable.
• Create visible open space between the outer edge of vegetation and the structure by pulling shrubs and ground cover back from the walls.
• Remove dead or dry material within the brush area nearest to the structure before it accumulates further.
• Thin trees and vegetation around the structure to allow clear sightlines and movement around all sides of the building.
